decisions.reason: The candidate already has a separate same-message MODIFY for quick, simple, preferably tool-free whisk removal. The bowl-clearance decision adds no necessary change to that state.
Unobstructed bowl removal does not change the requirement that spout components be removable for cleaning.
The source decision concerns mechanical clearance for lifting bowls and does not alter spout flushing or liquid-path cleaning behavior.
Bowl-removal clearance does not change the requirement for the bottom seal to prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The candidate's same-message requirement concerns operating height for foam quality and splash reduction. Bowl-removal clearance remains independently represented by the source Requirement.
The bowl-clearance change does not modify the existing splash-control target or mitigation options; the splash clause in the message is a separate concern.
Requiring clearance for bowl removal does not necessarily change the selected whisk design, material, or size.
The mechanical bowl-removal clearance requirement does not alter the required mixing smoothness, foam consistency, or texture.
Bowl-removal clearance does not change the dispensing path, pour control, dripping, sputtering, or beverage-preservation requirements.
The source decision has no effect on placard text, placement, or viewing orientation.
The source specifies clearance around the bowl but does not change its established capacity, depth, or refill policy.
Unobstructed bowl removal does not modify the requirement for leak-free plumbing and bowl seals.
